WITH asset_map AS ( SELECT ip, argMaxIf(name, last_seen, name != '' AND name != ip) AS asset_name, argMaxIf(manufacturer, last_seen, manufacturer NOT IN ('', 'unknown') AND mac NOT LIKE '4C:BC:48:%') AS vendor, argMaxIf(mac, last_seen, mac != '' AND mac NOT LIKE '4C:BC:48:%') AS mac_str FROM ntopng.assets WHERE type = 'host' AND ip != '' GROUP BY ip ) SELECT IPv4NumToString(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR) AS client_ip, coalesce( nullIf(replaceRegexpOne(anyLastIf(f.SRC_LABEL, f.SRC_LABEL != '' AND f.SRC_LABEL != IPv4NumToString(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR)), '\\.[^.]+\\.[^.]+$', ''), ''), nullIf(replaceRegexpOne(any(a.asset_name), '\\.[^.]+\\.[^.]+$', ''), ''), '—' ) AS hostname, multiIf( bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.132.0'), 'Trusted', bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.140.0'), 'Guest', bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.136.0'), 'IoT', bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.116.0'), 'Cameras', bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.120.0'), 'MGMT', bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.224.0'), 'Cellular', 'Other' ) AS zone, if(any(a.vendor) != '', any(a.vendor), '—') AS vendor, if(any(a.mac_str) != '', any(a.mac_str), '—') AS mac, count() AS flows, sum(f.TOTAL_BYTES) AS bytes, formatDateTime(max(f.LAST_SEEN), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%S') AS last_seen FROM ntopng.flows AS f LEFT JOIN asset_map AS a ON IPv4NumToString(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR) = a.ip WHERE $__timeFilter(f.FIRST_SEEN) AND f.INTERFACE_ID = 0 AND bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) IN ( IPv4StringToNum('192.168.132.0'), IPv4StringToNum('192.168.140.0'), IPv4StringToNum('192.168.136.0'), IPv4StringToNum('192.168.116.0'), IPv4StringToNum('192.168.120.0'), IPv4StringToNum('192.168.224.0') ) GROUP BY f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR ORDER BY bytes DESC LIMIT 100

list.definition: SELECT value, if(h != '', concat(h, ' — ', z, ' (', value, ')'), concat(z, ' — ', value)) AS label FROM ( WITH asset_map AS ( SELECT ip, argMaxIf(name, last_seen, name != '' AND name != ip) AS asset_name FROM ntopng.assets WHERE type = 'host' AND ip != '' GROUP BY ip ) SELECT IPv4NumToString(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR) AS value, multiIf( bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.132.0'), 'Trusted', bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.140.0'), 'Guest', bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.136.0'), 'IoT', bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.116.0'), 'Cameras', bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.120.0'), 'MGMT', 'Cellular' ) AS z, multiIf( bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.132.0'), 1, bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.140.0'), 2, bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.136.0'), 3, bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.116.0'), 4, bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) = IPv4StringToNum('192.168.224.0'), 5, 6 ) AS z_ord, coalesce( nullIf(replaceRegexpOne(anyLastIf(f.SRC_LABEL, f.SRC_LABEL != '' AND f.SRC_LABEL != IPv4NumToString(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR)), '\\.[^.]+\\.[^.]+$', ''), ''), nullIf(replaceRegexpOne(any(a.asset_name), '\\.[^.]+\\.[^.]+$', ''), ''), '' ) AS h FROM ntopng.flows AS f LEFT JOIN asset_map AS a ON IPv4NumToString(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR) = a.ip WHERE $__timeFilter(f.FIRST_SEEN) AND f.INTERFACE_ID = 0 AND bitAnd(f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR, 4294966272) IN ( IPv4StringToNum('192.168.132.0'), IPv4StringToNum('192.168.140.0'), IPv4StringToNum('192.168.136.0'), IPv4StringToNum('192.168.116.0'), IPv4StringToNum('192.168.120.0'), IPv4StringToNum('192.168.224.0') ) GROUP BY f.IPV4_SRC_ADDR ) ORDER BY z_ord, label
